modules.title: Lognormal Distributions and Simulation Techniques
modules.explanation: A lognormal model keeps compounded prices nonnegative, while simulation repeatedly samples assumed drivers to form a distribution of outcomes. The output is only as credible as the assumptions, dependencies, and number of trials.
steps: Specify the uncertain inputs, distributions, and correlations.
Generate many scenarios and calculate the outcome in each one.
Summarize percentiles and sensitivity, then stress assumptions the model may miss.

Quantitative analysis converts financial observations into comparable measures. The analyst must keep units and timing consistent, show the assumptions behind the calculation, and interpret the result rather than treating a computed number as self-explanatory.
